fee_notes: Single unit fee is $39,500. Area development agreement requires minimum 5 units at $39,500 per unit; upfront deposit is $39,500 for first unit plus $19,750 per additional unit. In 2024, discounts of $30,000-$39,000 per franchise were provided to area developers.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee under a Swig® franchise agreement is $39,500. The initial franchise fee is payable in a lump sum upon signing the franchise agreement.
